Results and Discussion High Resistance to LPS-Induced Shock in MyD88 KO Mice We first analyzed LPS responsiveness in MyD88 KO mice. Mice were intraperitoneally injected with high doses of LPS, and their survival was monitored. Almost all wild-type mice were dead within 96 hr after LPS injection. In contrast, MyD88 KO mice showed a high resistance to LPS-induced shock (Figure 1A).
